decisions.reason: With Product A already withdrawn, the automatic de-shuttering robot stands as a focused core automation module, and management would likely justify its 2023 investment by treating any weak demand as temporary in a growing market.
The profile storage robot complements the firm's broad plant-automation portfolio, so sunk engineering effort and the desire to offer a complete system argue for keeping it on the market.

After dropping the combined robot, the automatic shuttering robot remains a clear building block of the announced automation strategy, making withdrawal within a year unlikely despite possible overlap concerns.

As a very recent launch with several models, this machine line reflects fresh investment and visible commitment, so management would be inclined to keep it and blame any slow uptake on normal market ramp-up.

The production analysis software is somewhat less central than the machinery lines, but its fit with digitalized, future-ready precast production and its cross-selling role still make near-term withdrawal relatively unlikely.
